faqs.question: Is Electric 60’s 3300 kg the same frame as Electric 80?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 60 lists 3300 kg, 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Electric 80 lists 6000 kg, 110 kW, 60 m³/h. Hopper 0.7 m³ appears on both pages.
